Define a Hardened Air-Gapped Local LLM Container Specification

Source: R/container.R
airgap_container_spec.Rd

Creates a validated, digest-pinned container specification for running local open-weights LLM inference backends ("ollama", "llama.cpp", or "vllm") under strict network isolation (--network none), a read-only root filesystem, dropped Linux capabilities, and read-only local model mounts.

Usage

airgap_container_spec(
  backend = c("ollama", "llama.cpp", "vllm"),
  image = NULL,
  image_digest = NULL,
  model_dir = "/srv/airgapllm/models",
  model_file = NULL,
  model_digest = NULL,
  port = NULL,
  host_bind = "127.0.0.1",
  socket_path = NULL,
  gpu = c("none", "nvidia", "rocm"),
  gpu_devices = "all",
  memory_limit = NULL,
  cpus = NULL,
  shm_size = NULL,
  read_only = TRUE,
  network_mode = "none",
  cap_drop = "ALL",
  no_new_privileges = TRUE,
  user = NULL,
  tmpfs_size = "512m",
  env = list(),
  extra_args = character(),
  container_name = NULL
)

Arguments

backend

Character scalar selecting the local inference runtime: "ollama", "llama.cpp", or "vllm".

image

Character scalar container image name (without tag or digest, or with @sha256:... embedded). Defaults to the standard upstream image for backend.

image_digest

Character scalar pinned SHA-256 image digest ("sha256:<64 hex chars>"), or NULL if embedded in image or deferred for inspection by preflight_isolation_check().

model_dir

Character scalar local host directory containing model weights, mounted read-only at /models inside the container.

model_file

Optional character scalar filename (relative to model_dir) or full path to the GGUF/safetensors model weights.

model_digest

Optional pinned SHA-256 digest of the model weights.

port

Optional integer container port. Defaults to 11434L (Ollama), 8080L (llama.cpp), or 8000L (vLLM).

host_bind

Character scalar host interface binding when publishing a loopback port; defaults to "127.0.0.1".

socket_path

Optional local host path for a Unix domain socket bind mount used with --network none.

gpu

Character scalar GPU passthrough mode: "none", "nvidia", or "rocm".

gpu_devices

Character scalar specifying NVIDIA GPU devices (e.g., "all" or "device=0"). Ignored unless gpu = "nvidia".

memory_limit

Optional Docker memory limit string (e.g., "32g").

cpus

Optional positive numeric CPU core limit.

shm_size

Optional shared memory size string (e.g., "4g").

read_only

Logical scalar; mount container root filesystem read-only. Defaults to TRUE.

network_mode

Character scalar container network mode. Defaults to "none" (strict airgap). "internal" is supported for Compose internal loopback setups; other modes fail preflight_isolation_check().

cap_drop

Character vector of Linux capabilities to drop. Defaults to "ALL".

no_new_privileges

Logical scalar enforcing --security-opt no-new-privileges:true. Defaults to TRUE.

user

Optional non-root "uid:gid" string for container execution.

tmpfs_size

Character scalar size limit for writable /tmp tmpfs (mounted noexec,nosuid). Defaults to "512m".

env

Named list or named character vector of additional container environment variables.

extra_args

Character vector of extra backend CLI arguments.

container_name

Optional container name.

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_container_spec" containing the normalized specification and its canonical spec_digest.

Examples

spec <- airgap_container_spec(
  backend = "ollama",
  image = "ollama/ollama",
  image_digest = paste0("sha256:", strrep("a", 64)),
  model_dir = "/srv/models/llama3",
  gpu = "nvidia"
)
print(spec)
#> <airgap_container_spec>
#>   Backend:       ollama
#>   Image:         ollama/ollama@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaa...
#>   Network mode:  none
#>   Read-only:     TRUE | Cap-drop: ALL
#>   Model mount:   /srv/models/llama3 -> /models:ro
#>   GPU:           nvidia (all)
#>   Spec digest:   sha256:e3e4ddc2329c698ea1363e9a943cb7fae03bd1a3592dc233d9c2dabae893fb05
